title: Taking George Knapp through Los Alamos
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Taking George Knapp through Los Alamos, about 1989 at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was not all 100% legal, but yeah. George just walked around, filmed everything, spoke to people that I worked with
And we just rode right into the experimental areas, came over here, and said, "George, this is my desk."
tellings.difference: Adds that they rode into the experimental areas and Lazar showed Knapp his desk.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Lazar's firsthand account of taking George Knapp through Los Alamos in 1989.

as_told.title: Touring George Knapp through Los Alamos after going public

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien spacecraft for the US government in 1989, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he once brought George Knapp, a Las Vegas TV journalist, into Los Alamos, the government's nuclear research lab in New Mexico. Lazar admits it was not all legal, and says Knapp walked around filming everything and talking to his coworkers, and that they rode right into the experimental areas, where Lazar showed him his desk. He tells it as proof that he really worked there.
